positive_feedback: LLMInsightRequest / LLMResearchRequest preserve provider bodies, schema settings, OpenAI store=false, authentication headers, request size limits and timeout values while sharing HTTP construction.

SSEFramer preserves UTF-8 line reconstruction, CRLF handling, joined data-line accounting, EOF flush and finite line/event/wire budgets; extracted provider parsers retain terminal, refusal and usage semantics.

Transport byte scanning uses @concurrent while delivery is sequentially awaited on MainActor, with cancellation checked before delivery and after EOF; redirect refusal and ephemeral-session privacy settings are retained.
CI uses read-only repository permissions, disables persisted checkout credentials, pins both GitHub actions by commit, and verifies the downloaded SwiftLint archive by SHA-256 before execution.

The new transport regression test checks cancellation from both an EOF-sized payload and an intermediate chunk, asserts MainActor callback isolation, and verifies that only one callback is delivered; existing tests retain exact 2 MiB and overflow coverage.
Observation-based waits preserve the existing one-minute suite limits and cancellation checks; the meeting test injects a fixed timeline instead of weakening production consent boundaries.
